statement: Under Spain's Science Law, public research staff can take leave of up to 5 years to join a private company or work on their own account, only after 5 years' seniority.
source_title: Ley 14/2011 de la Ciencia, la Tecnología y la Innovación (consolidated, as amended by Ley 17/2022)
quote: con una antigüedad mínima de cinco años podrá ser declarado en situación de excedencia por un plazo máximo de cinco años, para incorporarse a agentes privados
caveat: Applies only to staff of public agents (public universities, public research bodies); not to private tech-centre foundations. Same 5-year value for seniority and maximum length.

statement: Leave under Science Law art. 17.4 is discretionary: it is subordinated to the needs of the service and the institution's interest, and an unanswered request counts as refused.
source_title: Ley 14/2011 de la Ciencia, la Tecnología y la Innovación (consolidated)
quote: La concesión de esta excedencia se subordinará a las necesidades del servicio y al interés que la universidad pública, organismo o entidad para la que preste servicios tenga
caveat: Silence-as-refusal wording: 'tendrá carácter desestimatorio'.

statement: The researcher-staff provisions of the Science Law apply to public universities, state public research bodies and research bodies of other public administrations.
source_title: Ley 14/2011 de la Ciencia, la Tecnología y la Innovación (consolidated)
quote: Las disposiciones de esta sección serán de aplicación al personal investigador que preste sus servicios en las Universidades públicas, en los Organismos Públicos de Investigación
caveat: BRTA technology centres are private non-profit foundations, so their staff fall under the Workers' Statute; whether Basque CICs/BERCs count as regional 'own centres' (DA 20ª) was not checked.

statement: The Science Law lets public researchers work part-time only in companies created or owned by their own institution, with the Ley 53/1984 limits on boards and on >10% equity waivable.
source_title: Ley 14/2011 de la Ciencia, la Tecnología y la Innovación (consolidated)
quote: prestación de servicios mediante un contrato laboral a tiempo parcial en sociedades mercantiles y otras entidades con personalidad jurídica creadas o participadas por la entidad
caveat: Part-time compatibility may not change the researcher's working hours (art. 18.2).

statement: Spanish public employees may not hold more than 10% of the capital of companies covered by the incompatibility law, nor sit on boards of related private companies, unless waived.
source_title: Ley 53/1984 de Incompatibilidades del personal al servicio de las Administraciones Públicas (consolidated)
quote: La participación superior al 10 por 100 en el capital de las Empresas o Sociedades a que se refiere el párrafo anterior.
caveat: Waivable for spin-offs under Ley 14/2011 art. 18.3 and LOSU art. 61.4.

statement: Private-sector employees (including tech-centre staff) on voluntary leave keep only a preferential right to a vacancy, not a reserved job.
source_title: Real Decreto Legislativo 2/2015, Estatuto de los Trabajadores (consolidated)
quote: El trabajador en excedencia voluntaria conserva solo un derecho preferente al reingreso en las vacantes de igual o similar categoría
caveat: Collective agreements may add other leave types (art. 46.6).

statement: Under the Workers' Statute, voluntary leave lasts between 4 months and 5 years and requires at least one year's seniority.

quote: excedencia voluntaria por un plazo no menor a cuatro meses y no mayor a cinco años

caveat: Only for companies participated by the university. Whether the implementing royal decree has been approved was not checked.
